title: Shakas and Kshatrapas: more on rulers, eras, terms

boxes.title: Order & conflicts: added
items: Order: Greeks (**326 BCE**) → Sakas → Kushanas (⚠ other notes: Greek phase 2nd c. BC)
Kushana period **1st-3rd c. CE**; empire extended beyond India
Sakas often at war with the **Satavahanas**
Rudradaman spared Satakarni as ==a close relative==
**Nasik Prashasti** of **Gautami Balashri**: destroyer of Shakas, Yavanas, Pahlavas

boxes.title: Inscriptions: added
items: Junagadh dated **Saka 72**; earlier inscriptions in Prakrit
Sudarshana: Suvishakha a **Pahlava** minister; Chakrapalita = son of governor **Parnadatta**

boxes.title: More eras & conversions
head: Item
Fact
rows: Also ==**Krit**, **Malav** Samvat==; victory over Sakas; **57/58 BC**

boxes.title: Terms, coins, culture
items: Many **silver coins** in western India; Kardamaka coins carry ==**Saka-era dates**==
Chashtana: silver & copper; copper relatively rare
Shared with Kushanas: trousers, long coats, helmets, boots; better cavalry

boxes.title: AP angle
items: After Rudradaman beat Pulumavi → Satavahana centre shifted to ==**Amaravati**==
Satavahana capitals: **Pratishthana (Paithan)**, Amaravati; Satavahana-Kshatrapa marriage alliance examinable
